title: MEIKO — Because They're Important〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, I have Luka and KAITO's orders.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Fruit sandwich combos for the both of them, a matcha latte for Luka and a cafe au lait for KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Got it. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku! I wanna order something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be right there.
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm still a little worried about Toya...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (He said he was going to look back upon his past, but I'm wondering what happened after we last spoke...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome...
Would you mind seating yourself at the counter? Things have been a little hectic today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Of course.
And I'll have my usual blend.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem a little better today...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you for the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I came to report on what I've been doing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I tried reflecting on my past like you suggested, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I took that opportunity to face something I wasn't able to before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: With the help of my dad, I was able to find a way to forgive myself for what happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Now, my song is coming along very nicely.
I've only just gotten started, but I have a good feeling about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, thank you again for what you did.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad to hear that I was able to help you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What are you two talking about? It sounds like a secret.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair!
Tell us what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thanking MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't taking care of myself, which caused her quite a bit of concern.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He made you concerned?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He didn't cause me any trouble, but I did have to nurse him a little back to health after I found him stumbling through the streets.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I knew it wasn't a good idea to push myself so hard, but I felt pressured to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was when MEIKO scolded me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No.
I can't just let you wallow in pain.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sit tight.
I'll go get you a drink from the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, you don't have to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya, do as I say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That gave me the time I needed to settle myself down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, MEIKO, I'm having a hard time imagining you scolding Toya like that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no reason to since Toya's usually so responsible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wanted to respect Toya's wishes since he was working so seriously at the time...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I became worried that his health would take a turn for the worse if he kept going at that rate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, you gave him a bit of tough love...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Then, that means you keep scolding us because...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, MEIKO!
I had no idea! Now I feel awful about running away all those times!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Me too!
I didn't realize you were thinking about what's best for us.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You two aren't feeling nearly as remorseful as you should.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sit down.
You're both long overdue for a proper scolding.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh oh...
